title: Shift 2 Unleashed
provenance: Reported by Dloshak (highball#241, 2026-10-25), Apple M1 Max Mac Studio with two displays, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, a separate environment with Steam: activation and menus reached, a race not yet. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Starts and reaches its setup screens on the default engine on an M1 Max, but has not reached a race yet. Every version uses TAGES Solidshield, which activates online through EA's servers, and its activation window stayed hidden while a second display was connected. The game needs NVIDIA's legacy PhysX, which it ships in its install\PhysX folder. On DXVK the GPU is lost as a race starts, with MoltenVK's Internal Error 0000010d right after passes drawn with no render target, the fault Portal 2's HDR pass caused. In DXMT mode (Direct3D 9 still goes through DXVK there) the window disappears when the game changes display mode. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The activation window never appears after Steam's CD key dialog
knownIssues.cause: it opens off screen when a second display is connected
knownIssues.fix: disconnect the second display for the activation, as for Steam's own sign in window (highball#479)

knownIssues.cause: the game needs NVIDIA's legacy PhysX runtime
knownIssues.fix: run install\PhysX\PhysX_SystemSoftware.exe from the game's folder with Run a Windows program… in the environment, then stop the environment

knownIssues.symptom: On DXVK the game hangs as a race starts with the sound looping (MoltenVK Internal Error 0000010d, then VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST)
knownIssues.cause: a GPU fault right after passes with no render target, as in Portal 2's HDR pass; not diagnosed for this game
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Untested: Wine's own Direct3D for this game

knownIssues.symptom: In DXMT mode the window disappears when the game changes display mode
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Untested: Emulate display mode changes in the game's settings
